title: Research: sharp invocation tariff for rank-bounded UT3 block calls
body:
The rank-one UT3 central-target floor does not determine the fewest invocations when a paid call may have scalar rank up to k. This package proves the sharp count **2 max(2,ceil(2w/k))** for every target count w and arbitrary finite restored dirty workspace, with a cyclic batching construction that simultaneously attains each letter's **2w rank units**.

For w=3,k=2 the complete formal boundary uses **six rank-two calls**, versus twelve rank-one calls or eight disjoint-block calls. All charge twelve total rank units. The sharp nonnegative affine per-letter tariff is `t(alpha_a+alpha_b)+2w(beta_a+beta_b)`, `t=max(2,ceil(2w/k))`: only invocation overhead can improve under rank-linear pricing. Scalar rank here is not an admitted supplier's recursive child rank.

Only `research/ut3-rank-bounded-block-calls/` is added: written uniform proof, deterministic receipt, full formal and faithful regular checkers, source/task pins and an explicit replay hook. The changed hypothesis is **paid rank-bounded couplings** in the two-letter alphabet. No central letter, clean allocation, free address maps, physical supplier or new kappa is claimed.

Validation on Windows / CPython 3.12.14, standard library:

- Registered optimized replay and two CLI/evidence-integrity test groups pass, including normal/optimized source export, read-only checks, receipt regeneration and four certificate mutations.
- 102 complete forward/inverse dirty fixtures, 16,160 regular basis columns, 27,931 arbitrary short words, 900 formal/regular two-factor comparisons and 1,060 same-label decompositions pass.
- 62 omitted-call and 10 model/boundary controls reject, including altered dirt, undercharged rank and a nonzero formal perturbation hidden by the lower-bound quotient. 306 rational tariffs pass.
- Package metadata/Git provenance, selected baseline bindings and whitespace checks pass. The restricted Windows temp path used an explicit writable scratch directory; the earlier flag-placement test mistake was fixed before the final replay.

Reproduce:

```sh
python scripts/research_package.py --package research/ut3-rank-bounded-block-calls
```

In a restricted Windows sandbox set `UT3_TEST_TMPDIR` to an existing writable scratch directory. The theorem is the written proof; finite fixtures corroborate it. Hosted CI is separate from local validation. Full selected cold replay, physical/compiler/common-label/hosting/precision interfaces, nonlinear recursive tariff, outer transfer, Lean and independent human review remain outside scope.

Base current main `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`; chooser nonce `c79b0a54a0d8afe483e69e03ae03fa5b`, revision 3, refined `bit-new-register-model`. [Claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1890). Final overlap snapshot: 556 open PRs including drafts and 536 Discussion body/comment/reply records, fully paginated at 13:41–13:42 UTC; local notes, UT3 and D8 aliases checked. No novelty guarantee.

Credit steph4n-gh #1573 (`0b8c5a69297c794f2de22c04494c83e41300ae36`), Arham Tahir #1589 (`010ec8c01c0edbbb08b541be236ab78d096f2ca1`), Hanson Sun #1607 (`9d6117918025cee6a0c5b7ef30ff8d936ca0621f`) and Josie Elliston #1792 (`cc3a4adbae23fb07687803d1361bb7a1bcd449b0`) for the inherited rank/coefficient method and rank-linear floor. The new result is the invocation optimum and cyclic batching; rank-volume preservation is credited corroboration. woklerx #1841 (`0c305488a4e27cd96edd61460bb5429ed5e8abf0`) treats the distinct added-central-label premise. The README retains the broader predecessor lineage and source licenses.

Next step: realize and completely price the six-call rank-two boundary against twelve rank-one calls. No physical realization is supplied. Prepared by **Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance** in proof, implementation, verification and writing; Apache-2.0; no subagents or independent human review.
